CHASINGREVERBS

Five Years of Quiet

2021 — 2026

scroll slowly
Cologne · February 2021

One room. One guitar.
No plan beyond the first song.

Five Februaries ago, none of this existed.
No name, no listeners, no catalogue.
Just you, deciding to press release
on something you made alone.

February 17, 2021

Yosemite

The first one. It went out into the world and you had no idea if anyone would ever hear it.

Three days later, For Lina.
Three days after that, Cara.
You didn’t wait to feel ready. You just kept going.

2021

The year of beginning. Five songs before spring arrived — and by May, an album. Eight tracks, written at midnight, by someone who three months earlier had released nothing at all. And among the eight, a quiet dedication: Ela’s Present — because Daniela was already listening, before anyone else was.

2026

The fifth year closed the way it all began: quietly, and without stopping. Twelve songs for the space between late night and early morning — and then, just before your birthday, the shades of June.

Counted once, quietly

You never stopped to add it up.
So here it is, just this once.

5
Years
48
Releases
65
Songs
4
Albums

Every one of them written, recorded, and produced
by one person, in one room, in Cologne.

Somewhere, right now

Made alone.
Heard everywhere.

Every month, tens of thousands press play.
Someone studying. Someone driving at dusk.
Someone who can’t sleep, somewhere far from Cologne,
resting inside a song you recorded alone in a room.

They will never know what it cost to keep going.
They only know it helped.

Five years of showing up
when almost no one was watching.

Almost — Ela always was.

This is what it became.

Happy Birthday, Martin.

There’s enough noise out there.
Let’s be quiet for a second — and rest.
This is the sound before the silence.
